sources.title: Taraxippos (Gutshot Straight + Explosive Payload) Damage Test
sources.acquisition: Downloaded entire short 21 s public creator gameplay, format 243, 640x360, 30fps, video only. No long video downloaded.

extraction.commandShape: ffmpeg -v error -i INPUT -ss SECONDS -frames:v 1 -q:v 2 OUTPUT.jpg (EP); Ammit decoded through image2pipe MJPEG and saved JPEG quality 93
extraction.timestamps: Filename seconds are requested source-video seek positions. Decode from start with output-side -ss; no fast input seek. Exact decoded PTS and action onsets were not independently measured.
extraction.images: Full uncropped decoded gameplay frames at source resolution, recompressed JPEG. Contact sheets only resize and add filenames outside image area. No synthetic/redrawn gameplay.
extraction.visualInspection: Actually inspected contact sheets and selected raw frames using view_image.

limits: Historical 2022/2023 creator recordings, not October 2026 sandbox certification or Bungie renderer source.
No exact number lifetime, rise velocity, pixel gap, collision algorithm, damage timing, or server tick calibration.
EP footage also has Gutshot Straight and Unstoppable Shot; damage values are not base EP coefficients.
Camera recoil and target motion confound upward screen motion. Independent float-up trajectory is unmeasured.
Observed overlap means strict nonoverlap is a local readability policy, not a proven Destiny invariant.
